column1: # [FABLE-5] (sq-hmd7l.20) Pinned timestamped replay — the EXPORTED copy of the fixed
# (fn single_window_script). This is the "identical timestamped replay" the bounded
# feeds to external RSP engines (RSP4J/YASPER). Events are sorted by ts (ascending).
# FIDELITY GUARD: bench/rsp/test_rsp4j_compare.py re-derives the per-window row counts
# from THIS file with an independent reference evaluator and asserts them against
# bench/rsp/expected.tsv — which run.sh in turn pins to the in-code script. A drift in
# either copy breaks that chain loudly. (The guard is count-structural: subjects,
# predicates, timestamps and window maths are covered; a literal-value-only edit that
# changes no per-window count is not observable at the count level.)
